member.name: DigestOutputFormatParamDoc
member.param: This optional parameter specifies the output format of the message digest. If omitted, the default is OuutputFormat.HexadecimalDigits, which outputs the digest as a string of hexadecimal digits. The other options are OuutputFormat.Base64String, which outputs the digest as a Base64 encoded string, and OuutputFormat.PrefixedBase64String, which outputs a Base64 encoded string that includes a prefix that identifies the hashing algorithm used to generate the digest. The prefix is derived from the name of the hashing algorithm, and is followed by an underscore character. For example, the 16-byte MD5 digest is represented by a string of 26 characters, beginning with "MD5_", and the 64-byte SHA-512 digest is represented by a string of 92 characters, beginning with "SHA512_".
